releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 287: Private Locker now supports Favourite Notes, Important Pin and Date Wise Diary. Favourite/Pin flags are encrypted with each note; search, editing, existing notes and lock/security settings are preserved.
